(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. 24, 73

__**72 + 1**__ = 73

73 = 73 (LHS = RHS)

And,

27, 82

__81 + 1__ = 83

83 = 83 (LHS = RHS)

So, checking each option one by one:

__96 + 1__ = 101

97 ≠ 101 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2) 32, 100

__32 × 3__ + 1 = 100

__96 + 1__ = 100

97 ≠ 100 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) 33, 101

__33 × 3__ + 1 = 101

__99 + 1__ = 101

100 ≠ 101 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 4) 33, 100

__33 × 3__ + 1 = 100

__99 + 1__ = 100

100 = 100 (LHS = RHS)

Thus, out of all the options, '33, 100' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)

(264, 43, 19)

(132, 27, 15)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (Second number - Third number) × 11 = First number

 
• (264, 43, 19) → (43 - 19) × 11 = 24 × 11 = 264
 
• (132, 27, 15) → (27 - 15) × 11 = 12 × 11 = 132

Similarly,

 
• (176, 39, 23) → (39 - 23) × 11 = 16 × 11 = 176

Hence, '**(176, 39, 23)**' is the correct answer.
